parsed.internal_thinking: I just rolled an 8, which gave me 1 Sheep. My current resources are 1 Ore, 2 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I cannot build anything or buy a development card yet as I lack Wood and Brick (and enough Ore/Wheat for a city). I have roads at 20-10 and 44-52. Node 10 is blocked because it is adjacent to my settlement at 20. I need to extend my road from 10 to 9 or 11, or from 52 to 51 or 53. Since I can't build or trade effectively with the bank (4:1), and I don't have enough to propose a meaningful trade that others would accept (most need what I have), I will end my turn.
